Interface PasskeyNameResolver

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface PasskeyNameResolver
Picks the name the passkey picker shows for an identity (the user entity's name and display_name). It is asked each time the identity starts registering a passkey, and who stores its answer.

    static PasskeyNameResolver
    preferring(Function<UUID, Optional<String>> credentialAddress, Function<UUID, Optional<String>> oldestAddress)
    A resolver that answers, in order: the address of the credential the session signed in with; otherwise the identity's oldest address; otherwise the identity id. who-passkey does not depend on who-email-link, so autoconfiguration passes the two lookups (backed by EmailCredentialService.findById and findOldestFor).

    • preferring

      static PasskeyNameResolver preferring(Function<UUID, Optional<String>> credentialAddress, Function<UUID, Optional<String>> oldestAddress)
      A resolver that answers, in order: the address of the credential the session signed in with; otherwise the identity's oldest address; otherwise the identity id. who-passkey does not depend on who-email-link, so autoconfiguration passes the two lookups (backed by EmailCredentialService.findById and findOldestFor).
      Parameters:
      credentialAddress - the address of a credential, or empty if it is not an email credential
      oldestAddress - the address of an identity's oldest email credential, or empty if it has none
      Returns:
      the resolver
